doc_friction.issue: Says calculators are a poor use of a run while the explore prompt leaves the choice free; I built one anyway because no venture covered voltage drop and the sibling tools list it as not modelled.
Takes one workflow per call; the hand-off message suggests two separate commands, which is easy to misread as one call with two arguments.

deviations.why: Built a calculator-shaped tool (voltage drop) despite the depth-over-calculators default: it fills the conductor-sizing gap beside service-load-check and pv-string-sizer, and its traps (2 vs root 3, one-way length, temperature, parallel sets, inverse questions) are what a chat answer often gets wrong.
deviations.result: merged with tests; usage not yet measured
